states.name: direct_entry
states.description: User opens estimator with no prior context.
states.placeholder: Ex. Ma porte frotte au sol et ferme mal
states.desktop_notes: Input centered, large font, generous padding.
states.mobile_notes: Input above keyboard, sheet expands on focus.

states.name: metier_selected
states.description: Métier resolved (by RAFI or user selection). Service disambiguation needed.
states.question: Quel type d'intervention souhaitez-vous ?
states.desktop_notes: Context strip above question, smooth transition from state 1.
states.mobile_notes: Sheet stays stable, context strip slides in.

states.name: service_selection
states.desktop_notes: Cards in 1–2 column grid depending on count.

states.name: simple_question
states.rafi_indicator: RAFI vérifie quelques détails avant d'afficher le prix.
states.desktop_notes: Single card per screen. Smooth 200ms transition between questions.

states.name: safety_question
states.description: Safety qualifier question. Serious, calm visual treatment.
states.desktop_notes: Subtle surface change signals seriousness without alarm.

states.name: quantity_input
states.description: Integer quantity question (e.g. number of cleaners, units).

states.name: measurement_input
states.description: Painted m² measurement input. PAGE_REQUIRED by orchestrator.
states.page_copy: Pour calculer correctement votre prix, nous avons besoin de la surface à peindre.
states.desktop_notes: Two-column page layout. Summary sidebar shows métier + peinture service.
states.mobile_notes: Single column. Summary collapsed to small strip.

states.name: standard_price_result
states.description: Standard fixed or conditional-fixed price result.
layout: CTA: Continuer avec ce prix — [AMOUNT] MAD
states.desktop_notes: Price is the largest element. Scope below. CTA gradient.
states.mobile_notes: Price visible without scroll. CTA sticky footer.

states.name: calculated_price_result
states.description: Calculated price with transparent basis shown.
layout: Basis line: e.g. '2 prestataires × 3 heures × 65 MAD'
CTA: Continuer avec ce prix — [AMOUNT] MAD
states.desktop_notes: Basis line in muted style above price.

states.name: labour_part_result
states.description: Labour fixed + variable part clearly separated.
layout: Card 2: Pièce / matériel | Non compris dans les [AMOUNT] MAD
Disclosure: 'Si l'artisan fournit la pièce, son prix doit être communiqué et approuvé avant installation.'
states.desktop_notes: Two distinct cards with clear visual separation.
states.mobile_notes: Cards stacked. Disclosure copy below cards.

states.name: diagnostic_result
states.description: Diagnostic price with métier-specific absorption explanation.
layout: Votre intervention nécessite d'abord un diagnostic.
states.desktop_notes: Clean. No extra decoration. Amount exact integer MAD.

states.name: quote_result
states.description: Quote required. Valid outcome — not an error.

states.name: route_result
states.description: Intervention falls outside métier scope. Redirect.
layout: Routing explanation: e.g. 'Cette intervention relève plutôt de la serrurerie.'
'FIXEO vous redirige vers le bon type d'artisan.'
states.desktop_notes: Brief and clear. CTA takes user into correct métier flow.

states.name: safety_stop_result
states.description: Safety trigger detected. No price shown.
layout: Une vérification est nécessaire avant de continuer.
Next action from orchestrator (e.g. contact emergency service / contact artisan directly).

states.name: modal_to_page_transition
states.description: Modal hands off to /estimation page. Session preserved.
states.trigger: orchestrator.ux_recommendation changes from MODAL_OK to PAGE_RECOMMENDED mid-flow
states.copy: Cette intervention demande quelques précisions supplémentaires.
states.desktop_notes: Modal closes, page opens with context intact. No progress lost.
states.mobile_notes: Sheet dismisses, page transition. No flicker.

states.name: estimation_page_complex_flow
states.description: /estimation page for complex flows (4+ questions or measurement dependency).

desktop_layout.right: EstimatorSummary (sticky) — métier, service, known answers, progress

states.progress: Stage 2 — Précisions (or Stage 3 if result reached)
states.desktop_notes: Page feels like expanded modal. Same visual language.
states.mobile_notes: Single column. Summary compressed to strip near top.
